mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(td_od_amount), 0) AS totalOrderAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN td_od_paid_status_code = '1' THEN td_od_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalPaidAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN td_od_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayOrderAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND td_od_paid_status_code = '1' THEN td_od_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayPaidAmount FROM td_order WHERE deleted = 0
